propositions: Sonnet 4.6 and Opus 4.8 share identical 1,000,000 token windows in MODEL_LADDER, causing escalation to opus to gain zero additional context capacity.
Context-limit retry that escalates from sonnet to opus fails silently at identical window size, consuming opus pricing without solving the original limit error.

escalation_rungs() must filter MODEL_LADDER to remove rungs whose declared windows are not strictly greater than the last kept rung, while models_at_or_above() remains unchanged for provider-stickiness and model-class resolution.
Both pass1_with_ladder and run_focused_finder must consume escalation_rungs() instead of models_at_or_above() to prevent guaranteed-failing paid retries.
Window figures (haiku 200K, sonnet 1M, opus 1M) are verified correct against provider live Models API; the defect is in consumption logic, not table values.
